rows: *Apocryphon of John*, Waldstein-Wisse long recension translation
Oroiael's first associated Aeon is rendered **Pronoia**; the third is Memory
Supports the stated local $(2,1)$ and $(2,3)$ readings \[[The Apocryphon of John - Long Version](https://www.gnosis.org/naghamm/apocjn-long.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]
First associated Aeon is rendered **Afterthought**; third is Memory
Confirms a translation-level discrepancy; does not establish a manuscript variant \[[The Apocryphon of John - Marvin Meyer](https://www.gnosis.org/naghamm/apocjn-meyer.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]
Presents an account involving the Logos's imperfect generation and restoration

Supplies a separate Valentinian generative account, not an independently verified copy of Irenaeus's six-pair list \[[The Tripartite Tractate -- The Nag Hammadi Library](https://www.gnosis.org/naghamm/tripart.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]
